notes: Amgen paid $28.3B for Horizon Therapeutics. Note: PORTFOLIO acquisition, not pure single-asset — Horizon's value was led by Tepezza (anti-IGF1R mAb for thyroid eye disease, FDA-approved 2020) but also included Krystexxa (uricase fusion for chronic gout) and Uplizna (anti-CD19 mAb for NMOSD). Peak sales estimate of $7.5B reflects the full portfolio's consensus across all three lead assets. EV/peak ratio is correspondingly a portfolio-blended figure. Include in the autoimmune-mAb cohort with this caveat because acquirers DO pay for portfolio-level autoimmune optionality, and the framing 'pure single-asset' undersells reality.
selection_rationale: Largest autoimmune M&A of the past decade. The portfolio-acquisition caveat is real, but excluding the headline autoimmune-biologic deal would leave the cohort with only Phase-2-era valuations and miss the post-approval / commercial-stage benchmark.
source: Amgen press release Dec 12 2022; Horizon SEC filings; Amgen Q4 2023 earnings (post-close performance disclosure).
